title: Rhode’s Road Map to $1 Billion in Sales
summary: After its $1 billion acquisition by E.l.f. Beauty, Rhode has the goal of being the fastest beauty brand to reach $1 billion in global net sales, fueled by record-breaking launches, strategic Sephora expansion and category innovation.
